detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"This game is really really good; I really enjoyed it."

-Jason Schreier (Triple Click Podcast/Bloomberg)

"Extremely well-designed detective game with nice discovery flow, memorable characters and magical realist setting"

Ernests Klavins (Case of the Golden Idol)

“One of the most unique environments and world building I've seen in the mystery genre.”

- Robin Ward (The Roottrees are Dead)

"Making surprising connections and unfolding such a layered story was a wonderful experience."

-Jeremy Johnston (The Roottrees are Dead)

"My overall pick of Next Fest."

-Lucy James (Lookingfor.game)

How do 700 people vanish in a single night?

The official story says that a fire had destroyed the town, along with all but one of the town's 724 residents.

The official story is false.

You'll search the ashes of the town, and travel through its past to find out what really happened.

Funeral for the Sun is an 8 hour long detective game rooted in Latin American history that lets you travel back in time and deduce secrets beyond your wildest imaginations.

Explore 400 years of history

70+ memories cling to the ashes of Cerro Milagroso. Each one of them is but a small part of a much larger tapestry.

Validate your findings

Build out your web of connections, one clue at a time.

  • Assign each character their correct name.

  • Establish relationships in a web of connections.

  • Sometimes a character's appearance changes over different parts of their life. Combine portraits together when they represent the same person.

  • Over 100+ Portraits to find!

SOMETHING SLUMBERS UNDERNEATH THE TOWN
